description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing git submodule handling, particularly involving 'git am' operations and submodule updates. It defines test cases, setup procedures, and helper functions to automate testing scenarios related to submodule behavior in git.

methods.name: am
methods.description: Executes 'git am' with a patch generated from a given revision, optionally trying a 3-way merge, and verifies the command's success or failure based on parameters.

methods.name: am_3way
methods.description: Executes 'git am --3way' with a patch, typically used for testing 3-way merge handling during patch application.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_func
methods.description: Runs a specified test function with different submodule switch options.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Sets up a testing environment, applies patches, updates submodules, and compares the resulting commit hash to expected output.
